scope: CPU numeric/source mapping diagnostic; no frames or scene descriptions inspected

text_vector_geometry.interpretation: Geometry only: shared direction or cosine concentration cannot establish semantic correctness or a model bug

shuffled_label_null.interpretation: descriptive global-label-permutation null only, not a significance test, independent evidence or semantic diagnosis

limitations: Saved IDs/hash/source encoding order support consistent label mapping; no semantic verification of a vector is possible from geometry alone.
Old window embeddings were not retained, so old scores cannot be independently recomputed as text-vector/window-vector dot products.
Text batch input token hashes were retained but not individual token sequences; API controls need a new frozen replay.
Concentrated ranks are not proof of an implementation error; a text, model, scene or task effect has not been isolated.
Known anchors are partial development labels, with correlated windows and repeated rule IDs;47 rule IDs unevaluated.
